. the rosary will be recited every tuesday morning after the 9 30 am mass during the month of october . coming home for christmas: a special christmas concert with tenor gavan ring and soprano nicola ring accompanied on piano by gary beecher: friday dec 4th 7 30pm in the o’connell memorial church, cahersiveen. tickets €30. contact the parish office divine mercy retreat at the oratory, waterville starting at 7pm fri 30th oct & at 9am sat 31st oct. speaker is aidan byrne, known for his catholic faith formation through radio maria ireland & divine mercy conference. this beautiful retreat will help us deepen our relationship with the lord & our blessed mother as we enter into the month of the holy souls. for info contact noreen or text
